# r/AtlantaHawks (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Atlanta Hawks stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Atlanta Hawks in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #21 Jalen Johnson 63.2
- #39 Dyson Daniels 58.9
- #77 Onyeka Okongwu 53.9
- #94 Nickeil Alexander-Walker 52.9
- #138 CJ McCollum 47.8
- #204 Jock Landale 43.6
- #234 Aaron Wiggins 41.9
- #270 Kingston Flemings 40.1 (rookie)

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
